description: This file contains SQL scripts defining a table for Orleans reminders, functions for upserting and deleting reminder rows, and queries for reading reminders, specifically tailored for PostgreSQL.

methods.name: upsert_reminder_row
methods.description: Function to insert or update a reminder row, incrementing the version on conflict.

methods.name: delete_reminder_row
methods.description: Function to delete a specific reminder row based on service, grain, reminder name, and version.
